reasons: Information Provision Agreement process requires legal-entity documentation/LEI and network diagram.
Direct connection requires Market Data User ID, network setup and TMI connection ID.
Published lead times are approximately one month for Market Data User ID, two months for network connection (four to six for 10G), and one month for TMI connection ID.

indirect_path_assessment.rationale: The Free Trial process explicitly supports receiving information from a Direct User and requires that Direct User's approval.
indirect_path_assessment.next_required_fact: Identify a provider willing to deliver exact Nikkei 225 Micro individual-month realtime data over an internal read-only internet/API transport under the OSE-approved trial.
